One HTML file, works offline, licensed for 365 days from first activation. UPI payment, file and PIN sent by email.

posts.title: Open Materia Medica — Paperback
posts.summary: The physical edition of Open Materia Medica: a single-volume reference covering 344 homeopathic remedies, each portrait giving the core picture, the traditional symptoms, the historical origin and the actual pharmacology and toxicology of the source substance, with traditional claims kept visibly separate from unproven clinical evidence. Compiled from six public-domain masters: Boericke, Clarke, Kent, Allen, Nash and Farrington.
